recommendation.reason: The best finding-kind accuracy (the only reliable question) is 0.957 (TypeSafe Jev 1.14). The chosen default is `Perplexity Decider v1.3 (free)` at $0.000000 per 1,000 items and 1.623 s mean latency. The best model is +0.043 above it (95% bootstrap interval [+0.000, +0.150]), so the two are statistically indistinguishable. `Liquid d1.2-ultra` is the paid alternative with the highest finding-kind accuracy (0.957) and all-question micro 0.566, but it costs $0.211079 per 1,000 and buys no clear accuracy gain.  The ranking is 23 reviewer findings, so its interval is wide; `label_ok` is descriptive only because its reference is defective until T31/v2.1.  This is a reviewer-finding sorter, not a general label-audit gate.
